questions.stem: Which of the following statements about radiotherapy in a 52-year-old woman diagnosed with stage 2B carcinoma cervix is incorrect?

options.label: A
options.text: Point B is 3 cm lateral to point A

options.label: B
options.text: Point A is 2 cm above the external os and 5cm lateral to the internal uterine canal

options.label: C
options.text: Point A receives a dose of 7000 cGy

options.label: D
options.text: Point B receives a dose of 6000 cGy
